title: Engine NE and Bkup Speed Sensor Error
detail_of_failure: Errors occur in the signal circuits of the engine Ne speed sensor and the engine Bkup speed sensor at the same time.
machine_effect: • Engine stops. • Engine does not start.
related_information: After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Start the engine.

steps.procedure: Defective connection (incorrect connection) of Ne speed sensor and Bkup speed sensor can be the cause. Check it.
Do the checks on causes 1 to 10 for failure code [CA689].
Do the troubleshooting for failure code [CA778].
If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
